Lines: # Explore: fade short at 09:45 (costed, short side)

Signal at 09:45 ET from bars ending by then: premarket high (bars 04:00-09:29) >= +30/50/100% over the adjusted prior close, close at 09:45 >= +20% over it, and extension from the 09:30 open (close at 09:45 / 09:30 open - 1) < 10/5/0%. Entry: short at the open of the first bar at or after 09:45. Exits: cover at the open of the first bar at or after 15:55 or 11:00; stop none/+10%/+20% over entry, filled at the worse of the stop and the bar's open (a gap or halt through the stop fills at the open); optional VWAP reclaim (a one-minute close above the 04:00-anchored session VWAP after a close at or below it covers at the next bar's open). Signal and clock fills after a missing minute are halt fills at the first post-halt open.

Costs: the frozen round trip at $1,000 (Corwin-Schultz over D-1..D-5 x the premarket multiplier 9.393 from spread-multiplier.json, square-root impact on the 04:00-09:45 volume, 0.5% floor). The frozen model has no regular-hours spread: the premarket multiplier is applied unchanged to these 09:45+ fills, which likely overstates the spread after the open. Borrow: 0 %/50 %/200 % APR, actual/360, one day per intraday short; trials and the main table carry 50 %. Historical easy-to-borrow / locate status is not available, so every name is assumed borrowable: results are as is, with no locate failures and no hard-to-borrow fee spikes. Rule 201: SSR is in force on D when D-1's low is at least 10% under D-2's close (the `explore ssr` cache); the uptick variant enters at the first bar within 30 minutes whose open is above the prior bar's close (optimistic: a real short must be priced above the bid), the skip variant drops the name. Reg SHO: names on a threshold list on D-1 (`x.regShoListedD1`) are included or dropped.

Margin: net / capital tied up, at Alpaca's short requirement (under $5 the greater of $2.50/share or 100% of value; from $5 the greater of $5/share or the Reg T 50% initial). Pooled = every train day (the fit year 2021-11..2022-10 included: nothing is fit); fold columns are the four eval windows. Worst 1% = the weighted 1st percentile trade. LOMO = leave-one-month-out: the lowest lower bound with any one month dropped.

Population: 2,724 train panel rows >= +19% at 09:45 (panel prefilter); 0 without a prior close, 0 without bars, 52 without a premarket or 09:30 bar, 212 under +20% on the bars. 2,460 names >= +20% at 09:45 over 708 days; 569 under SSR on D (0 with no SSR value, treated as not restricted); 121 on a Reg SHO threshold list on D-1.
